episodes.synopsis: Musashi Miyamoto receives the Oni Gauntlet for 33 days — along with a reluctant chaperone to watch over the precious item.
episodes.title: Demon

episodes.synopsis: The men arrive in the village, but it seems to be abandoned. While exploring the area, they come across a little girl who's all on her own.
episodes.title: Mountain Demon

episodes.synopsis: While leading the men to lemon's fortress, Sayo notices that there's something strange about the path that they're taking.
episodes.title: Nightmare

episodes.synopsis: The men arrive at the mountain temple and are confronted by three masked figures. While Musashi fights them, Kaizen, Sahei and Heikuro try to save Sayo.
episodes.title: Bewitch

episodes.synopsis: The Yoshioka family isn't through with Musashi and his men yet. With Sayo suffering from a fever, Sahei leaves to forage for medicinal herbs.
episodes.title: Yin Soul

episodes.synopsis: A strange man named Alfred welcomes Musashi and his friends into the lavish golden mountain before politely — but firmly — asking them to join Iemon.
episodes.title: Oni

episodes.synopsis: Years ago, Kensuke Matsuki acknowledged his young disciple's abilities, giving him the name Iemon and joining him in his wicked ambitions.
episodes.title: Harbinger

episodes.synopsis: While escaping with Sayo, Sahei comes across Iemon, who begs and barters with him to save his life. Then, the third traitor reveals themselves.
episodes.title: Yang Soul
